[*Question 4 of 5: Same forecast, different portfolio?*]{.agenda-q}

### [Same Forecasts, Different Portfolios: Factor Normalization and Regularization](/research/same-forecasts-different-portfolios.qmd)

Same forecasts, different portfolios: the small constant a portfolio rule adds to each factor's risk is a penalty on factor bets, written in the ruler's units, so one number gives two portfolios (Sharpe ratios 0.69 and 1.07 before trading costs, 594 months). Written in one set of units, or removed, the penalty gives one portfolio.

[Mingyang Liu]{.authors}
